HOME_SUBTITLE: Sign in with email and password using the same user model as the mobile app.
REGISTER_SUBTITLE: Registration for psychologists and patients with an invite code.
REGISTER_PATIENT_SUBTITLE: Patient registration with your psychologist's invite code.
REGISTER_PSYCHOLOGIST_HINT: Create your professional account to manage patients and sessions.
REGISTER_PATIENT_HINT: Create your patient account. The psychologist invite code is optional and can be added later in your profile.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Invalid credentials or user not registered.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_HINT: Enter your account email. We will send a link to reset your password.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_SUCCESS: If the email is registered, you will receive a password reset link.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_ERROR: Could not send the recovery email. Please try again.
FORGOT_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE: Password recovery is not available in demo mode.
REGISTER_PHONE_HELP: Enter mobile number with area code (10 or 11 digits).
REGISTER_ERROR_PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter a valid mobile number with area code.
REGISTER_INVITE_CODE_HELP: Optional. Ask your psychologist for the code or add it later in My profile.
REGISTER_ERROR_GENERIC: Could not create account. Please try again.
REGISTER_SUCCESS_LOGIN: Account created successfully. Sign in to continue.
PATIENT_AREA_SUBTITLE: Chat with the AI agent by text or audio and receive guided feedback.
LIKERT_CHECKIN_HINT: Rate each item from 1 (very low) to 5 (very high). Your answers help your psychologist during the session.
LIKERT_SAVE_ERROR: Could not save self-assessment. Please try again.
TOOLTIP_LIKERT_CHECKIN: Likert self-assessment used as clinical context in your psychologist session.
PSYCHOLOGIST_AREA_SUBTITLE: Track patient interactions, annotate sessions, and tune AI context for daily patient guidance.
PSYCHOLOGIST_DASHBOARD_SUBTITLE: Clinical overview with interaction metrics and care plan adherence.
PSYCHOLOGIST_SESSION_SUBTITLE: Record session notes, consult the AI, and tune clinical context during the appointment.
END_SESSION_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: You will return to the patient dashboard. Saved session notes and chat history will be kept.
TOOLTIP_CHART_MOOD_TREND: Latest mood trend point, estimated by the AI agent from patient conversations and refined when the psychologist ends the session.
TOOLTIP_CHART_MOOD_DIARY_ADHERENCE: Share of days with patient interaction with the AI agent (chat or audio) in the last 7 days.
TOOLTIP_CHART_WEEKLY_INTERACTIONS: Patient interactions per weekday (chat, audio, notifications) in the current week.
TOOLTIP_CHART_INTERACTION_CHANNELS: Channels used by the patient this week: text, audio, and notifications.
MOOD_DIARY_HELP: Enter a value from 1 (very low) to 10 (very good).
MOOD_DIARY_SAVE_ERROR: Could not log mood. Please try again.
MOOD_DIARY_INVALID_SCORE: Enter a whole number between 1 and 10.
TOOLTIP_MOOD_DIARY: Your entry feeds mood diary adherence on the psychologist dashboard.
TOOLTIP_CHART_CLINICAL_THEMES: Mentions per clinical theme, incremented by the AI agent when the session ends based on the psychologist's session notes.
PROFILE_INCOMPLETE_ALERT: Some profile data was not provided by the auth provider. Please complete:
PROFILE_LANGUAGE_HELP: Sets the language for Mind Bridge on this device.
PROFILE_INVITE_CODE_HELP: Enter the code to link your care to a psychologist. Leave blank if you do not have one yet.
PROFILE_SAVE_ERROR: Could not save profile. Please try again.
PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_FORMULA_BODY: Total = patient-months × price per patient. Any patient enabled on at least one day in the month is billed, even if disabled later. Account discounts apply to the subtotal.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_CURRENT: Current month charge uses the patient-month rule: anyone enabled at any point in the month is billed.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_FORMULA: Disabling a patient on the last day of the month does not remove that month's charge. The per-patient price is set by the platform.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_COST_CHART: Monthly history of net cost after discounts.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_PATIENTS_CH: Patient-months recorded each month (closed on the 1st of the following month).
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_BILLING_PATIENTS_DE: Patients included in this month's charge (patient-month rule), with enable and disable dates.
NOTIFICATION_BODY: How are you feeling today? Share a quick update with your AI care assistant.
SESSION_SAVE_ERROR: Could not save. Please try again.
SESSION_END_ERROR: Could not end the session. Please try again.
DEFAULT_PATIENT_AI_CONTEXT: Support daily reflection and emotional awareness with empathetic language.
DEFAULT_PSYCHOLOGIST_AI_CONTEXT: Encourage healthy routines, active listening, and reflective questioning.
AI_ERROR_NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Sign in to chat with the agent.
AI_ERROR_PATIENT_REQUIRED: Select a patient to use the copilot.
AI_ERROR_GENERIC: Could not get a response from the agent. Please try again.
AI_AGENT_UNSAFE_RESPONSE: I cannot respond to harmful or discriminatory content. If this is an urgent safety concern, please seek immediate professional help.
AI_AGENT_DEFAULT_RESPONSE: Thank you for sharing this. Can you tell me more about how you felt before and after this situation?
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_CHAT: Chat with the AI agent by text or audio. Responses use your care plan and recent history.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_CHAT_AUDIO: Use the microphone to dictate your message. Text will appear in the field before you send.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_SUMMARY: Automatic summary of your AI interactions, including recurring themes and self-care suggestions.
TOOLTIP_PATIENT_NOTIFICATIONS: Enable browser reminders to stay engaged with your care plan between sessions.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_CONTEXT: Set the clinical context the AI should prioritize when analyzing interactions and generating patient insights.
TOOLTIP_SESSION_NOTES_AGENTIC_SUMMARY: Automatic synthesis of psychotherapy session notes from prior sessions to support today's clinical focus.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_SESSION_NOTES: Psychotherapy session notes: agenda, techniques used, and items to review at the next appointment.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_CHAT: Ask the AI to consolidate patient data, detect patterns, and suggest clinical guidance.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_SUMMARY: Aggregated view of the patient's AI interactions, including metrics, risk, and plan adherence.
TOOLTIP_PSYCHOLOGIST_INSIGHTS: Automatically suggested indicators, patterns, alerts, and actions to support your clinical decisions.
SESSION_NOTES_READONLY_HINT: Viewing a past session — editing is disabled.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_SUBTITLE: Manage patients linked to your care relationships.
PSYCHOLOGIST_INVITE_CODE_HINT: Share this code so patients can sign up and link to your practice automatically.
PSYCHOLOGIST_INVITE_CODE_REGENERATE_CONF: Generate a new code? The current code will stop working.
PSYCHOLOGIST_INVITE_CODE_REGENERATE_ERRO: Could not generate a new code.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_MODAL_SUBT: Set the clinical context the AI agent uses in patient interactions.
Clinical context for {name}'s interactions with the AI agent.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_PLACEHOLDE: E.g. CBT approach, anxiety focus, therapeutic goals…
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_SE: Choosing an option copies the text into the field below. You can edit before saving.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_TR: Goal: identify triggers in everyday interactions (conversations, work, family).
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_SO: Goal: explore social situations that cause nervousness or discomfort (meetings, colleagues, events).
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_MO: Goal: track mood and impact on sleep; identify what worsens or improves rest.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_WO: Goal: map sources of work stress and how the patient reacts emotionally.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_EXAMPLE_EM: Goal: help the patient recognize emotions as they arise, without judgment.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the patient's context.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_CONTEXT_SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the context. Please try again.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_SUBTITLE_ADD: Fill in the details to link the patient to your care.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_SUBTITLE_EDI: Update name, contact, or reset the patient's login password.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_ACCOUNT_HELP: Email and password the patient uses to sign in to the app.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_PHONE_HELP: Enter mobile number with area code (10 or 11 digits).
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ERROR_PHONE_REQUIR: Enter a valid mobile number with area code.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_INITIAL_PASS: Set a 5-character alphanumeric password (letters and numbers) for the patient to sign in.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_MODAL_RESET_PASSWO: Leave blank to keep the current password. Minimum 5 characters.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ERROR_PASSWORD_INV: Enter a valid 5-character alphanumeric password (letters and numbers).
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ERROR_RESET_PASSWO: New password must be at least 5 characters.
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_DELETE_CONFIRM: Remove this patient from your list?
PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_API_UNAVAILABLE: Sign in with Supabase (disable auth bypass) to manage patients via the API.

PSYCHOLOGIST_PATIENTS_ROW_HINT: Click a patient row to open the dashboard. Use the buttons on the right for session, edit, or delete.
